format: UTF-8 JSON Lines; one row per origin and segment in samples.jsonl, one row per origin/candidate/seed in predictions.jsonl

semantics.origin_id: stable zero-based target start index within an individual time series
semantics.target: length H array of finite numeric truth in common target-standardized scale
semantics.prediction: length H array in same scale as target
semantics.cutoff_index: last observed numeric index, strictly less than origin_id
semantics.preprocessing_fit_end: exclusive final target index used for fit statistics; must not exceed train_end
semantics.seed: single integer for numeric candidate or one of protocol seeds for an ensemble member
semantics.feature_manifest_sha256: SHA256 digest of assistant-one feature manifest; identical across sample/prediction rows
semantics.config_sha256: SHA256 digest of assistant-two model config; constant per candidate and task

rejection: missing/duplicate IDs, mixed hashes or versions, missing target/prediction, nonfinite or wrong-length arrays, out-of-segment target window, future preprocessing, or missing row-null evidence causes explicit failure
